title: Warm-up Characterization and an Open-Weight Harness for Lean Refactor Arena
goal: Ship a Leanstral-backed local harness in this repo that rewrites warm-up proof bodies under Lean-as-oracle, without inventing Arena scores or treating Spark NVFP4 wall-clock as official Track 2.

subgoals.title: Leanstral generate_text and docker0 HTTP client
subgoals.description: Fail-closed generate_text against live docker0 Leanstral; never LOCK_EX; never a second llama-server.

subgoals.title: Prefix splice and lexical admission
subgoals.description: Bind statement via src.startswith(statement) on all 15 warm-up records; admit tactic blocks only.

subgoals.title: Lake compile toolchain and dedicated verifier
subgoals.description: Pin elan tags, bake oleans, compile one Strata file then all tags, fail-closed verify_lra_batch.

subgoals.title: Warm-up loop v1 on this machine
subgoals.description: run_warmup.py: splice, Leanstral when /health is ok, lexical admit, lake compile, keep-best. Unscored.

subgoals.title: TypeSafe Jev distill after v1
subgoals.description: Optional typed gates via ipfs_accelerate_py.typesafe_inference. Off on official Track 2.

subgoals.title: Optional Track 1 budget path
subgoals.description: Prepare grok+Jev in-loop under US$3/problem. Not the default winning path.

subgoals.title: Deferred lake-native hammers and JSONL retrieval
subgoals.description: Loop v2 only. Do not claim LeanFrontend.snapshot_goal is lake-ready.

subgoals.title: Optional INSERT-only proof receipts
subgoals.description: Filesystem receipts remain authority for warm-up. DuckDB INSERT-only if used.

subgoals.title: Official Track 2 gate
subgoals.description: SM80 GGUF derived from Frosty40 NVFP4 plus named 4xA100 by 2026-10-15, or do not enter Track 2.

subgoals.title: Manuscript measured section and human submission
subgoals.description: Fill Approach/Models/Budget only from receipts. Submission is manual.

tasks.title: Thin fail-closed Leanstral generate_text entry point
tasks.description: Implement papers/completion/lean_refactor_arena/harness/generate_text.py as an HTTP client of 172.17.0.1:8080. Probe /health. Call ipfs_accelerate_py.llm_router.generate_text with fail-closed kwargs. Do not import LeanstralProofProvider. Do not start llama-server. Do not claim scores.
acceptance_criteria: generate_text uses provider=leanstral_local, model_name=Leanstral, temperature=0.0, allow_local_fallback=False, allow_cross_provider_fallback=False, disable_model_retry=True.
Unreachable docker0 fails closed without Grok/HF fallback; receipts record resolved provider/model.
No LOCK_EX; no second llama-server; no compile; no Arena scores.

tasks.title: Prefix splice tests on all 15 warm-up records
tasks.description: JSONL splice is src.startswith(statement). ArkLib/CSLib statements contain := in types. Write harness/splice.py and a unit test over data/benchmark_data_warmup.jsonl. Lexical admission uses statement + ' := by\nsorry' plus tactic-only proof_text.
acceptance_criteria: Every warm-up record satisfies src.startswith(statement); body is the suffix after the statement.
Never scan for the first :=; named := inside types remains part of the frozen statement.
Unit test covers all 15 records; SHA-256 of the JSONL remains 6209680cf00cde0765b77b24834cd72c64dd585b2f7e3f2a58209980ab59a804.

tasks.title: Tag-pinned Lean/lake toolchain resolver
tasks.description: Add lean_toolchain.py next to hammers/frontends/lean.py. Compile worker will use run_lean_process. Do not make LeanFrontend.snapshot_goal lake-aware in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Resolver returns tag-pinned elan lean and lake paths from JSONL version_info.
EnvironmentLockRecord is populated via executable_paths, not primary_executable.
LeanFrontend PATH lean --json behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: Bake lake oleans and Putnam Mathlib lake projects
tasks.description: First lake build is hours. Bake oleans before the 48h clock. Putnam records have empty url/file_path and import Mathlib/Aesop.
acceptance_criteria: Strata v4.26 olean bake is recorded first; missing cache fails closed under network=deny.
Putnam is a per-tag Mathlib+Aesop lake project, not Tmp.lean.
No Arena scores.

tasks.title: Multi-tag lake compile worker starting with one Strata file
tasks.description: Cached clone, checkout commit, lake env lean. Measurement command forces finite maxHeartbeats even if Putnam headers zero it. Expand tags after one file is green.
acceptance_criteria: One Strata module compiles via lake env lean with finite measurement maxHeartbeats.
Per-tag timeout and axiom-digest receipts are written.
IndependentKernelVerifier 30s default is not the lake oracle.

tasks.title: Dedicated verify_lra_batch fail-closed verifier
tasks.description: Copy the fail-closed pattern from law_to_action verify_batch without sharing that missing path. --require-complete.
acceptance_criteria: Verifier requires digest, statement-bind, all listed tags, no sorryAx, one receipt per scheduled problem.
Does not import law_to_action verify_batch.py.
Does not write Arena scores.

tasks.title: Docker0 HTTP client; never owner LOCK_EX
tasks.description: gpu-0.lock is the owner lock held by law_to_action / run_leanstral_ephemeral.py. LRA is a client of the live server.
acceptance_criteria: Probe http://172.17.0.1:8080/health; if healthy, generate_text as client without LOCK_EX.
IPFS_ACCELERATE_LLAMA_CPP_AUTOSTART=0; never start a second llama-server.
If unhealthy and gpu-0.lock free, may exec run_leanstral_ephemeral.py --bind docker0 --gpu 0; if EX held, wait or skip LLM.

tasks.title: run_warmup.py loop v1 using Leanstral on this machine
tasks.description: Primary execution path. Exclusive GPU client of 172.17.0.1:8080. Transfer is a hard filter; composite is tokens+elab among valid candidates. Reference proof is a legal no-op if generate is skipped.
acceptance_criteria: When /health is ok, loop v1 MUST call Leanstral; skip generate only if docker0 is down.
Loop is splice, optional generate, lexical admit, lake compile, keep-best; hammers and TypeSafe off.
Failures retained; no Arena scores; hardware_class=spark_gb10.

tasks.title: Warm-up runbook wired to verify_lra_batch
tasks.description: Freeze file schema plus runbook. Completing this task is not official Track 2.
acceptance_criteria: Operator command runs 15 problems on Spark with hardware_class=spark_gb10.
Completing requires verify_lra_batch --require-complete PASS.
Does not write Arena scores into the manuscript.

tasks.title: TypeSafe Jev router via in-tree typesafe_inference
tasks.description: TYPESAFE_API_KEY will exist. Frozen ROUTE_QUESTIONS. CI fixtures without live key. Additive on top of Leanstral, not a replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Imports ipfs_accelerate_py.typesafe_inference, not a second typesafe_sdk client.
Default LRA_TYPESAFE=off; distill uses LRA_TYPESAFE=distill; official Track 2 stays off.
Score is a rubric index; Jev does not generate Lean.

tasks.description: Closed generator is grok/grok-4.6 through llm_router.generate_text. Prepare, do not default.
acceptance_criteria: Hard stop at US$3/problem including Jev+grok.
Not the default winning path; skip if keys missing.
Does not contaminate Track 2 receipts.
